scope: ACT0 continuation: make the existing pre-implementation MVP epoch audit consumable through an immutable RECOVERY_RESUMED event without falsely advancing the product Work Order to IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/AUDITED. R2 itself passed all 291 Harness tests; this closes the remaining post-merge operational resume gap before ACT0 acceptance.
required_outputs: Raw exact-head logs and preserved negative control
stop_conditions: A product stage must be fabricated to record the pre-implementation audit
Historical event or schema changes are required
risk_reasons: Epoch continuation controls runtime authorization after main movement

design_brief.problem_statement: _select_epoch_audit only consumes AUDIT_COMPLETED/AUDITED; a freshly DISPATCHED MVP cannot legally reach AUDITED before implementation, so the documented post-merge resume would remain blocked.
design_brief.current_behavior: After canonical adoption the exact base is an ancestor, but Drive routes to INTEGRATOR until an audit that the early-state selector cannot consume is recorded.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Committed exact post-merge audit plus INTEGRATOR RECOVERY_RESUMED/DISPATCHED allows continuation without marking any MVP implementation or acceptance predicate complete.
design_brief.selected_design: Extend only _select_epoch_audit for MVP-eligible epochs and an exact command/actor/state/identity-bound RECOVERY_RESUMED reference. Read immutable committed audit bytes. Preserve the existing AUDIT_COMPLETED path and epoch-validator semantics.
design_brief.why_selected: Uses existing events and owner roles, remains fail-closed, and avoids a new scheduler or authorization service.
dependencies: Existing epoch validator and immutable event provenance
expected_risks: Wrong-main or uncommitted audit accidentally authorizes continuation
Recovery evidence incorrectly counts as product completion
validation_plan: Exact predecessor selector must retain INTEGRATOR for the newly tested valid recovery record
Candidate must route same case to IMPLEMENTER
Wrong actor, command, main, identity and dirty/uncommitted evidence remain blocked
Full Harness regression and exact candidate control

notes: Bounded Director continuation of owner-authorized ACT0. No audit result or independent verdict is manufactured. R2 artifact 10099478950 from run 34340278878 has SHA256 86ebd03467fd336cf06812dc01e0cbcf178848660a32cfe3145d19af599eaba5; 291 Harness and 13 ACT0 tests passed.
